name: Fairytales and First Timers: The Minnows of 2026
angle: The expanded 48-team World Cup was a stage for the smallest nations: Curacao's record-breaking debut and Eloy Room's 15-save wall, Cabo Verde reaching the knockouts as the smallest nation ever to do so, and first-ever knockout runs for Ivory Coast and DR Congo. Curated and de-duplicated from the daily World Cup quiz series.

questions.question: World Cup debutants Curacao earned their first ever point with a goalless draw. Which side did they hold?

Curacao were beaten 7-1 by Germany but still made history in the match. Why?

options.A: They scored their first ever World Cup goal
options.B: They became the smallest nation to win a point
options.C: They conceded the fastest goal in tournament history
